name: Dental Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Dental Corporation Public Company Limited provides dental services and products in Thailand. It provides dental diagnosis and general dentistry, oral surgery, dental implants, cosmetics dentistry, endodontic dentistry, periodontics dentistry, prosthodontic dentistry, and orthodontic dentistry services, as well as dental laboratory services; and distributes dental supplies and equipment. As of December 31, 2020, the company operated 14 branches. Dental Corporation Public Company Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
